work.summary: Closed the bounded FINAL.18 OCR visit-flow maintenance cycle. The real-device sales-journal issue was caused by compact-review rerenders dropping mount callbacks/options; corrected sales reviews could therefore confirm without post-confirm follow-up actions. FINAL.18 preserves those callbacks and explicitly routes OCR visit closeout to the existing Today completion flow for the trusted matching machine, reusing the existing task checklist and order confirmation. PR #108 merged, Vercel production is READY, GitHub Pages serves FINAL.18, and production/live regression gates pass.
implemented: Compact OCR rerender now preserves the mount options/callbacks instead of remounting with an empty options object.
A corrected sales journal therefore still creates/uses the Analytics visit and shows post-confirm follow-up actions after explicit confirmation.
Explicit OCR visit closeout captures the Analytics visit machine before reset and, when that machine is in Today's target set, invokes the existing normal completeVisit workflow.
The existing task checklist and order confirmation behavior are reused rather than duplicated.
Closing the OCR modal directly does not mark the Today machine visited.
If there is no trusted machine association or the linked machine is not a Today target, legacy Today completion is not forced.
Added regression coverage that performs a sales previousClearAt correction causing a rerender before draft/confirmation and verifies post-confirm actions still appear.
Regression gate also checks deployed index wiring from OCR closeout to normal Today completion plus the existing task/order path.
Merged PR #108 to main at d2eab9b1fb7f06a788f70e149bd17f5764c79235.
